description: A sink in the rock holding water the colour of a bruise, lit from underneath by nothing that should be lighting it. The rim is worn smooth in three places by a great many feet. There are offerings: wire, teeth, a child's shoe, a wedding band. The air over the water shakes. Whatever is in this pool isn't a metaphor and it doesn't care who you are, and everybody who has ever come here came here on purpose.
name: The Quickening Pool
